product.summary: Nunchuk's current wallet application for single-user, multi-user and multisignature Bitcoin custody workflows.
product.notes: Current product identity is first-party supported; initial Nunchuk Wallet launch date remains unresolved.

events.title: Nunchuk introduced its multisig wallet
events.description: Nunchuk published its introductory announcement for the Nunchuk multisig wallet, documenting the product as available in November 2020.

events.title: Nunchuk unveiled a redesigned Group Wallet
events.description: Nunchuk announced a redesigned Group Wallet that removed the prior Matrix dependency, derived a shared encryption key from wallet output descriptors, simplified cross-device recovery, and made the collaborative multisig wallet available to all Nunchuk users.

evidence.title: Nunchuk — Secure Your Bitcoin for Generations
evidence.notes: Current first-party site actively distributes the Nunchuk app and describes supported self-managed and collaborative wallet configurations.
